title: AMI
text: Co-design SerDes architecture with other vendor designs, 1 input, 1 output, {DLL File} sets Executable file DLL file; {AMI File} sets the aMI settings, {Operation} defines whether block is used as transmitter or receiver and {Correlation Flow} defines whether block runs in parallel with another transmitter. Values come from the instance.

params.name: DLL File
params.values: Executable file DLL file | SO file

params.name: Operation
params.values: Define whether block is used as transmitter or receiver Tx (default) | Rx

params.name: Correlation Flow
params.values: Define whether block runs in parallel with another transmitter or receiver off (default) | on
